input.overview: The left and center kickers load torpedoes and start Multiball. Shoot the left kicker twice, or the center kicker followed by the left, for instant two-ball play. For three-ball play, collect one left and one center load, then shoot either kicker again. Destroy any colored ship four times to light its Jackpot.
input.simpleOverview: Shoot the left kicker twice for two-ball Multiball, or shoot center then left. For three-ball Multiball, shoot both kickers once and then either one again. Spell S-U-B to spot colored torpedoes. Destroy the same colored ship four times to light its Jackpot.
input.summary: Left twice, or center then left, starts two-ball Multiball. Left plus center, then either kicker again, starts three-ball Multiball. Spell S-U-B to spot torpedoes and destroy one colored ship four times to light Jackpot.

quickInfo.name: Start 2-Ball
quickInfo.summary: Shoot the left kicker twice, or the center kicker and then the left.

quickInfo.name: Start 3-Ball

quickInfo.name: Light Jackpot
quickInfo.summary: Destroy the same colored ship four times.

steps.text: Shoot the left kicker twice for instant two-ball Multiball, or load the center kicker and then shoot the left.
For three-ball Multiball, collect one left-kicker load and one center-kicker load, then shoot either kicker again.
Complete S-U-B to spot the lit colored torpedoes.
Destroy one colored ship four times to light its Jackpot, then follow the lit collect indicated by the machine.

alternatives.title: Use the right ramp and spinner
alternatives.when: Use this when the kicker feeds are difficult but the right ramp and spinner are repeatable.

steps.text: Shoot the right wireform ramp and right spinner to load torpedoes through the longer route.
Combine that progress with the left kicker so the next qualifying load begins Multiball.
Keep one ship color in focus rather than spreading hits across every bank.
After destroying the required ships, watch the left orbit for the fleet hurry-up.
Use Multiball protection to finish dangerous ship-bank shots before taking the lit collect.

machineSetup: Confirm whether extra ball, special, and Jackpot values are altered for tournament play.
Test the left and center kickers, ball locks and releases, S-U-B lanes, colored ship banks, right wireform, right spinner, and left orbit.

cautions.issue: The order of the kicker loads determines whether the game begins two- or three-ball Multiball.
cautions.response: For three balls, make sure both left and center have been loaded once before taking the third kicker shot.
